summary: Extract source-labeled, minimized findings from an approved private transcript set while retaining scope, redaction, uncertainty, and revocation evidence.
triggers: An explicitly approved private session export must answer a named question.
A bounded transcript set needs a source-labeled pattern ledger.
Private evidence requires minimization, redaction, or retention tracking.
antiTriggers: Monitor live conversations without a fixed approved scope.
Mine another person's sessions or infer identity secrets.
Reuse a private finding for a new purpose without renewed scope.

provenance.note: Method source read in full and independently rewritten for portable product use; the historical file remains unchanged.
Scope, minimization, redaction, and retention semantics informed the rewrite; no source prose was copied.
Ownership and evidence boundaries were consulted; the product entrypoint does not claim an executed mining result.
